posts.text: If this was a one-off I might even believe they’re doing it intentionally but there’s a longer history here of bizarre PR decisions by the W. Here’s my question: the wings have so many guards and a 6’4 19 year old w so many skills went third… drafting fudd is crazy!

The way the league and wings have handled this is so weird unless the intention is to make everyone talk about it all day and speculate wildly about their number 1 pick. It would take one ‘yes we are together but I’m here to hoop’ and this goes away.
